programme.desc: Two small-time crooks, Jimmy and Johny, blackmail hotel manager Balram Sahni aka Ballu in order to get a huge sum of money. But their plan goes haywire when Ballu is mysteriously murdered.

programme.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 1
programme.desc: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success.

programme.title: Naya Raasta
programme.desc: Chander, a criminal lawyer, gives up his successful career and returns to his ancestral village. There, he comes face-to-face with social problems such as casteism, untouchability and poverty.

programme.title: Justice Choudhary
programme.desc: Justice Chowdhary gives up his moral values and determines to seek revenge after his entire family is abducted and killed in his presence.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: Ajay Kumar, a successful and famous doctor, is on a quest to prove his innocence when he is accused of murdering his wife Swetha. He seeks the help of Ramya, a cop who secretly loves him.

programme.title: Phir Milenge
programme.desc: A woman is fired from an ad agency when her employers get to know that she is HIV positive. Upset by her unfair dismissal, she seeks a lawyer to fight her case and restore her dignity.

programme.title: Sheesha
programme.desc: Dinesh and Maneesha fall in love and, soon after, get married. However, things get complicated for the newly-wed couple as Poonam, Dinesh's colleague files a serious case against him.

programme.title: Yaarana
programme.desc: Kishan and Bishan Kumar were childhood best friends. Young Bishan lives a wealthy life with his mom and Kishan was a former servant cum cook who later turns out to be a successful singer.

programme.title: Aradhana
programme.desc: Musical hit romantic drama tells the story of a pure hearted women, her motherhood and the sacrifices she endures over her lifetime. Starring Rajesh Khanna and Sharmila Tagore.

programme.title: Mangalsutra
programme.desc: Vijay lives a wealthy lifestyle with his widowed dad, Mohan, and is betrothed to Gayetri Prasad when they were still children. Now both are adults and are attracted to each other.

programme.title: Aaj Ki Awaz
programme.desc: A mild-mannered but conscientious citizen turns vigilante to counter police apathy but pays a price for it when mafia kill his family. Devastated, he takes on the criminals in a fight to the finish.

programme.title: James
programme.desc: James comes to the city of dreams hoping to make it big. Working as a bouncer at a nightclub, he gets on the wrong side of a powerful political family.

programme.title: Ek Chalis Ki Last Local
programme.desc: A comic thriller about two people who miss the last local train at 1:40 am and how missing of their train changes their course of life forever.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Dr Pran Lele
programme.desc: DR PRAN LELE, A quirky, mad-cap doctor - Dr. Pran Lele along with his crazy Nurse CPR is here to provide an abundant dose of LOLs & ROFLs as they treat their celebrity patients in their unique ways.

programme.title: Vansh
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers who hated each other unite when they discover their bigamous father is in danger. They fight the villains to save him.

programme.title: Naya Daur
programme.desc: A man brings turmoil to a peaceful village by disturbing the livelihood of the local farmers and workers. He does this by introducing new machinery in an attempt to make quicker profits.

programme.title: Sawan Ki Ghata
programme.desc: A man arranges his daughter's marriage to prevent her from marrying the man who truly loves her.

programme.title: Ajanabee
programme.desc: Middle-classed Rohit (Rajesh Khanna) falls in love with rich Reshmi (Zeenat Aman) and marries her. But fate has other plans and he gets arrested for the murder which he never committed.

programme.title: Dil Hai Betaab
programme.desc: Meena and Raja, who are in love with each other, decide to marry. However, when her father's employer asks for Meena's hand in marriage, he accepts his proposal. Will Meena accept this alliance.

programme.title: Pratigyabadh
programme.desc: Shankar grows up to become the right hand of a gangster. His goal in life is to take revenge on the moneylender who rendered his family homeless and a truck driver who molested and killed his mother.

programme.title: Dahleez
programme.desc: Mrignaini and Shekhar love each other, but due to a misunderstanding, Mrignaini decides to leave him. She then marries another man. Her life comes crashing down when Shekhar reappears in her life.

programme.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
programme.desc: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

programme.title: Zabardast
programme.desc: Ratan steals diamonds for a gangster, Balram Singh, but after learning about the latter's evil intentions, he decides to keep them. Later, believing his family to be dead, Ratan goes on the run.

programme.title: Kya Dil Ne Kahaa
programme.desc: Esha and Rahul fall for each other and decide to get married with the approval of their parents. However, much to her shock, he refuses her proposal when her parents come to meet him.

programme.title: Nishchaiy
programme.desc: When Ravi is falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to imprisonment, his boss' wife promises to take care of his younger brother. However, Ravi is unable to find his brother after he is released.

programme.title: Jeevan Ek Sanghursh
programme.desc: Karan, a thief, works for Dr. Devraj to help keep the evil don Rattan from taking over the city. His life changes when he finds his family that had disowned him when he was a child.

programme.title: Itni Si Baat
programme.desc: When Raja and Asha get married, they realise that Raja's income is not sufficient for them and their two children. Asha then decides to get a job while Raja stays at home to look after the children.

programme.title: Baharon Ki Manzil
programme.desc: A woman (Meena Kumari) whose memory is impaired learns shocking information about her family.

programme.title: Jaago
programme.desc: A young Shruti is molested on a train in the presence of co-passengers who remain mute spectators. After she dies of the trauma, her parents, along with the investigating officer, fight for justice.

programme.title: Ghar Ka Chirag
programme.desc: A wealthy widower marries the daughter of a school principal when her lover is assumed dead. Five years later, her lover returns and sets out to find the truth behind her marriage.

programme.title: Kabhi Na Kabhi
programme.desc: Jaggu gets arrested after a witness informs the police about his crimes. Meanwhile, Raja is hired in his place. Once out, Jaggu kills the witness, who happens to be Raja's father.

programme.title: Souten The Other Woman
programme.desc: After the sudden death of her lover, Mitali gets married to a wealthy widower, Ranbeer. However, her secrets are soon revealed.

programme.title: Arjun Devaa
programme.desc: Arjun Poojari, a villager, becomes a dacoit after the Thakur's brothers sexually assault his sister. The Thakur hires Devaa, a dreaded contract killer, to avenge Arjun, who kills his siblings.

programme.title: Bundal Baaz
programme.desc: Trash collector Raja finds a magic lamp with a genie that insists on helping him. After a few disastrous adventures, Raja tries to get rid of the pesky genie.

programme.title: Naseeb
programme.desc: When Pooja's father disapproves of her relation with Krishna, a humble man, he vows to become wealthy and returns to find that she is already married.

programme.title: Patthar Ke Sanam
programme.desc: Rajesh works for Meena's father. Meena and her friend Taruna decide to play a prank on him. Both women pretend to fall in love with him, but he finds out, resulting in acrimony.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
programme.desc: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

programme.title: Yakeen
programme.desc: A couple meets with a car accident. The husband suffering from amnesia finds evidence, that all had not been well in his previous life. He grows suspicious of the people around him including his wife.

programme.desc: A woman goes on a hunt to find her twin sister's rapist and murderer.

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: A peek behind the facade of Australia's dramatic desert scenery, where there lurks a motley crew of silent assassins, con-artists, gang members and brutal brawlers.

programme.title: Boss Shark

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist
programme.desc: A year in the life of Canada's common loon, examining the perils impacting its population - from global warming and boat traffic to big wakes disturbing its habitat.

programme.title: Rewilding
programme.desc: Documentary about the European bison, the continent's biggest terrestrial mammal, which was hunted to extinction but has been re-introduced thanks to rewilding.

programme.title: Rewilding
programme.desc: A visit to Steinhuder Meer, a biodiversity hotspot in Germany, a combination of fenlands, alder march and dunes which create an amazing landscape.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Documentary revealing how the African elephant has conquered the continent, following three vastly different herds - a matriarch leading her family across the merciless Namibian desert, a family protecting its young calf on the unforgiving planes of the Okavango Delta and a bull elephant searching for a mate along the immense Zambezi River.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: A look at how, to survive Australia's hostile landscapes, animal inhabitants must always have a plan. They all rely on strategic behaviour to thrive.

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: A look at the cannibalistic spider crab and venom-sporting platypus - proof that nowhere does strange quite like Australia.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: Sri Lanka's parched lowlands, a forest clearing that is a peaceful home to monkeys, deer and wild boar - and a prime hunting ground for crocodiles.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon
programme.desc: An elephant on the cusp of adulthood must leave one herd and join another - but gaining the acceptance of a new family will prove difficult.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm
programme.desc: As the leaves change, wild urges grip the animals. Rams Roger and Hamish battle for dominance, while Sally the hen flies the coop for a tour of the farm.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm
programme.desc: The farm animals settle down for the shortest day of the year. To stave off boredom, the cows enjoy holiday treats and a concert, while Sheila is busy with her nine piglets.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys
programme.desc: Following the devastating Tsunami of 2011, Japan is going through a seismic crisis. This edition takes a closer look at two of the country's most dangerous volcanos.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: The struggle for dominance in the natural world, from elands locking corkscrew horns to striped marlins spearing unsuspecting prey.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: The scavenging antics of nature's clean-up crew, as Tasmanian devils get into food fights with rivals and dung beetles roll over the competition.

programme.title: Wild Crusades: The Monkey Diaries
programme.desc: The life of a toque macaque monkey hiding out in the jungles of Sri Lanka. But as its contact with humans increases, it begins to change in rather unexpected ways.

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.desc: Following a 750km journey down the Drava river, starting with the current's Alpine origins to its delta in the Pannonian Basin.

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.desc: Diving into the great floodplains that lie along the Drava River, areas that are at risk of intense seasonal flooding, before exploring the wetlands of Kopacki Rit.

programme.title: Colombia's Wild Coast
programme.desc: The remote island of Gorgona, once chosen by the Colombian government as a prison site due to its shark-infested seas and impenetrable jungle teeming with deadly snakes.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster explores the Galapagos, a collection of volcanic islands in the Pacific known for its extraordinary wildlife. More than 150 years after Charles Darwin formulated his ground-breaking theory of evolution on the remote archipelago, Attenborough explains how life on the islands has continued to evolve in biological isolation, examining how the ever-changing volcanic landscape has given birth to species and sub-species that exist nowhere else in the world. He begins by revealing how Galapagos rose from the ocean four million years ago.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster reveals how life has learnt to adapt quickly in the ever-changing volcanic landscape, resulting in species that exist nowhere else in the world. David investigates the driving forces behind their evolution, exploring the appearance and behaviour of remarkable creatures and vegetation including giant whale sharks, marine iguanas and seemingly normal dandelion seeds that grow into plants the size of trees.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his exploration of the archipelago with a look at how, despite their proximity, no two of the 19 islands are the same. He also uncovers evidence that evolution on Galapagos is occurring faster than Charles Darwin could ever have imagined, and encounters Lonesome George, the last remaining giant Pinta Island tortoise, who died just a few weeks after filming in June 2012.

programme.title: The Bachelor King
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the lives of king penguins, filmed on the sub-Antarctic island of South Georgia over five months. The programme imagines what one penguin's life would be, following it during the challenging, awkward time between adolescence and adulthood. Presented by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough employs the latest technologies to explore the violence, rivalries and deadly weaponry existing within the world of bugs. This first episode examines the survival tactics of its terrifying residents including killer ants, trap-setting spiders and beetles with the ability to shoot boiling chemicals at their enemies.

programme.title: Islands
programme.desc: A look at the ecosystems of six islands, examining how the geology and origins of each have forced the animals that evolved there to interact as they do nowhere else. The first edition looks at the flora and fauna of Canada's Vancouver Island.

programme.title: Islands
programme.desc: A look at K'gari in Queensland, also known as Fraser Island, with footage of stingrays hunting soldier crabs in the tidal shallows, acid frogs evading vicious predators.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: An insight into the lives of elephant bulls in Mount Kilimanjaro and Amboseli, following their drive for dominance and the subtle social bonds that form between them.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms
programme.desc: The wonders of Africa's most amazing landscapes, beginning at the Drakensberg mountain range, where baboons and eland are just some of the creatures coping with a hostile environment featuring cliffs that rise sharply from the landscape.

programme.desc: The Cloud Mountains of South Africa, a hidden world that serve as a window to an ancient time.

programme.title: Attenborough and the Giant Elephant
programme.desc: Naturalist David Attenborough investigates the life of Jumbo, a famous Victorian elephant, supposedly the largest that ever lived. Attenborough examines Jumbo's remains and considers the lives of elephants in the wild to learn more about the animal's difficult life.

programme.desc: Director Kevin Macdonald's acclaimed, hugely powerful documentary recreating the terrifying struggle for survival faced by mountaineers Joe Simpson and Simon Yates, who braved the Peruvian Andes. During the descent, one of the men fell, breaking his leg and forcing his friend to leave him - but remarkably he beat all the odds to survive. The story is told in the climbers' own words and features dramatised reconstructions of their ordeal starring Brendan Mackey and Nicholas Aaron.

programme.title: Tanked

programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Kamikaze: An Untold History
programme.desc: Kamikaze, explosive-laden ramming attacks, were carried out during World War II and sacrificed 4,000 lives - why did the Japanese push forward with this method? We uncover the truth.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.desc: Matsue is known as the 'city of water.' It is home to Lake Shinji, which is famous for its shijimi clams. Through beautiful time-lapse footage, we see the lake's changing colours and expressions.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Let's Trek Japan
programme.desc: Discover a hiking destination loved across Japan. Explore vast wetlands alive with delicate flowers and wildlife, meet the warm people protecting this wonder, and enjoy an exciting climb.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan
programme.desc: Shizuoka has everything from beaches to mountains, but this time our road takes us through its deep forests from wild rides on timber trails to a wild taste experience in the birthplace of wasabi.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Design X Stories
programme.desc: Today's theme: Guruguru Designs. Nature's spirals, circles, and swirls are reflected in 'guruguru' designs. From prehistoric pottery to modern art and fashion, these shapes still fascinate us today.

programme.title: Story Land
programme.desc: Leading actors take turns as solo storytellers to act and recite traditional folk tales loved in Japan for centuries - watch out for some delightful illustrations too.

programme.title: Texico
programme.desc: Learn programming principles without a computer! Animated characters provide fun and lucid explanations of five core processes: analysis, combination, generalisation, abstraction and simulation.

programme.title: Samurai Wisdom
programme.desc: Yoshimune is the shogun who saved the city of Edo - through disaster and economic strife, his wisdom alongside its people shaped the future of the place now called Tokyo.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey
programme.desc: Deep Culture: Kyle Card explores the San'in Kaigan Geopark and uncovers Yumura's hot springs, Ojiro's hillside rice terraces and heritage Tajima beef, and the Oriental White Stork wetlands of Toyooka.

programme.title: Ukiyo-e Edo-Life
programme.desc: A Stylish Concert: A master koto player delights a crowd of gorgeously dressed celebrity types at a New Year's concert at a samurai residence, and in the best seat in the house is no ordinary VIP..

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Aichi / Kataoka Mami (curator). Tokoname, a pottery town with over 900 years of history, creates products appropriate for the times. Kataoka finds the beauty that's present in functional objects.

programme.desc: Explore the different types of romantic hero who appear in kabuki. From sweet, comic charmers to brooding bad boys, actor Kataoka Ainosuke explains these heroic archetypes.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: An upper-class suburban teenager gets involved with a prostitute while his parents are away on holiday, turning the family home into a brothel and jeopardising his plans for the future. Coming-of-age comedy, starring Tom Cruise, Rebecca De Mornay, Bronson Pinchot and Joe Pantoliano.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: An advertising executive tries to start a new life in California with his family and their lumbering, disaster-prone Great Dane. The friendly but clumsy dog accidentally causes chaos for his owners, until an incident at a surfing competition makes him a local celebrity. Comedy, with Lee Pace, and featuring the voice of Owen Wilson.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: A host of weird and wacky characters cause mayhem at an exclusive golf club, including a laid-back professional player, an obnoxious millionaire, the snobbish club president, a motley collection of teenage caddies and a psychotic groundskeeper engaging in a fight to the death with a canny gopher. Comedy, starring Chevy Chase, Bill Murray, Michael O'Keefe and Rodney Dangerfield.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: A former member of a singing trio, now running a hotel on a Greek island, is reunited with her old bandmates for her daughter's wedding - but is surprised when three of her old flames also show up unexpectedly. The three men have been invited by the bride, who wants to find out which one of them is her father. Musical comedy, with a soundtrack of Abba songs, starring Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Julie Walters, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgard and Amanda Seyfried.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: It's five years since Sophie invited her three possible dads to her wedding, and now most of her family are reunited as she prepares for the grand reopening of the Hotel Bella Donna. Along the way, she learns more about her mother's past. Abba-themed musical sequel, starring Amanda Seyfried, Lily James, Pierce Brosnan, Cher and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: An eccentric but brilliant former cop sets himself up to champion the underdog - as a private eye specialising in locating missing animals. The zany detective is called in to find a kidnapped dolphin - the mascot of an American football team - and uncovers a plot involving high-level police corruption. Comedy, starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young, Tone Loc and Noble Willingham.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: The eccentric pet detective is coaxed out of self-imposed exile in a Buddhist monastery to visit Africa and help search for a sacred white bat. However, his unique investigative talents are tested to the limits as he faces a race against time to find the missing creature and prevent a tribal war. Comedy sequel, starring Jim Carrey, Simon Callow and Bob Gunton.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: A disorganised woman is asked to be maid of honour at her best friend's wedding. Taking charge of the prenuptial bridal celebrations, she resolves to give her pal and accompanying bridesmaids the time of their lives, but as her efforts slide into chaos she finds the wife of the groom's boss is keen to usurp her position. Comedy, with Kristen Wiig, Rose Byrne and Melissa McCarthy.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Nurse Greg is now the proud father of twins, but has yet to earn the respect of his wife's stern father after 10 years of marriage. The couple invite both sides of their extended family to the kids' birthday party, where Greg makes a desperate effort to finally prove his worth to his father-in-law. Comedy sequel, with Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Owen Wilson and Dustin Hoffman.

programme.title: Bean
programme.desc: The hapless fool is employed as a security guard for a British art gallery and is sent to Los Angeles to bring back a famous painting. Unfortunately, he finds himself mistaken for a renowned art professor and invited to make an important presentation. Mel Smith's British comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, Burt Reynolds, Peter MacNicol, John Mills, Peter Capaldi and June Brown.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: An eccentric but brilliant former cop sets himself up to champion the underdog - as a private eye specialising in locating missing animals. The zany detective is called in to find a kidnapped dolphin - the mascot of an American football team - and uncovers a plot involving high-level police corruption. Comedy, starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young, Tone Loc and Noble Willingham.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: The eccentric pet detective is coaxed out of self-imposed exile in a Buddhist monastery to visit Africa and help search for a sacred white bat. However, his unique investigative talents are tested to the limits as he faces a race against time to find the missing creature and prevent a tribal war. Comedy sequel, starring Jim Carrey, Simon Callow and Bob Gunton.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Jack, a struggling musician, gets hit by a bus during a mysterious event. When he regains consciousness, he finds that he is the only person who can remember the Beatles, and sets out to exploit the opportunity by passing their hits off as his own compositions. Comedy, with Himesh Patel and Lily James. Directed by Danny Boyle.

programme.title: American Pie
programme.desc: Four teenage lads make a solemn pact to lose their virginity before the high-school prom. Though their antics cause them huge embarrassment and public humiliation, the friends also learn about love and affection in their relations with the opposite sex. Coming-of-age comedy, starring Jason Biggs, Shannon Elizabeth, Chris Klein, Alyson Hannigan, Mena Suvari, Seann William Scott and Eugene Levy.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: The teenagers reunite after their first year at college to spend the summer at a lake house. Jim is concerned by his lack of sexual experience, and goes in search of an old flame, Oz struggles to keep a long-term relationship going, and Finch tries to master the art of tantric sex. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Biggs, Chris Klein, Seann William Scott, Alyson Hannigan and Eugene Levy.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: The friends from East Great Falls High reunite to celebrate Jim and Michelle's forthcoming wedding. Though reluctant to invite Stifler to their big day, the happy couple relent - but regret their decision when he plans a bachelor party on the same evening Jim is due to meet the in-laws. The third instalment in the comedy series, with Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan, Seann William Scott, Eddie Kaye Thomas and Eugene Levy.

programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: Jim Levenstein and his old friends return to their home town for a high-school reunion. Struck by how much their lives have changed, they set out to relive the sexual misadventures of their adolescence, but only end up making bigger fools of themselves than they did as teenagers. Comedy sequel to the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan.

programme.title: Bean

programme.desc: Two brothers plan to pull off an ambitious heist during a Nascar race in North Carolina, but first they need the help of a convicted safe-cracker - who is currently doing time in prison. Steven Soderberg's crime caper, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver, Daniel Craig and Riley Keough.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Two rivals in the bookshop business fall in love over the internet, unaware they know and dislike each other in the real world. While things remain frosty in person, the pair's anonymous online relationship continues to blossom. Romantic comedy, starring Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Greg Kinnear, Parker Posey and Dabney Coleman.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Recently widowed Bridget enters the dating game once again, caught between her son's science teacher and a man 20 years her junior. Romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Hugh Grant, Leo Woodall and Colin Firth.

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: Down-on-his-luck suburban dentist Nicholas Oseransky is horrified to discover his new neighbour is a former hitman, who is now in hiding after turning evidence against gangland bosses. When his wife convinces him to contact the Mob to try to extort money in exchange for revealing the crook's location, Nicholas finds himself out of his depth and in mortal danger. Comedy, with Matthew Perry, Bruce Willis, Rosanna Arquette and Michael Clarke Duncan.

programme.title: The Cable Guy
programme.desc: A man makes the mistake of engaging a cable TV installer in conversation in a ploy to get all the channels for free. However, the manic repairman shows an invincible determination to be his new best friend - and does not take kindly to rejection. Comedy directed by Ben Stiller, starring Jim Carrey, Matthew Broderick and George Segal.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A former 10-pin bowling champion prodigy turns conman and hits the bottle when an accident leads to the loss of his hand. To revive his flagging fortunes, he goes all out to persuade a gifted Amish man to take up the sport professionally so he can cash in on his prize-winnings. Comedy from the Farrelly brothers, starring Woody Harrelson, Randy Quaid, Vanessa Angel and Bill Murray.

programme.title: Honey Don't
programme.desc: California private detective Honey O'Donahue delves into a series of unusual deaths connected to a mysterious church. Co-writer/director Ethan Coen's comedy mystery, starring Margaret Qualley, Aubrey Plaza and Chris Evans.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Heroes

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

She helps them as they face their toughest challenge yet - defeating a sinister criminal organisation that seems to have power over the entire city. Fantasy adventure, starring Megan Fox and William Fichtner, with the voice of Johnny Knoxville.

Comedy sequel, starring Will Ferrell, Christina Applegate, Paul Rudd and Steve Carell.

Comedy horror, starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda, Oliver Platt, Brendan Gleeson and Betty White.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde.

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A team of scientists and a soldier of fortune comb the Borneo jungle for a rare species of orchid with valuable medicinal properties, but get more than they bargained when they encroach on the territory of a nest of gigantic and deadly snakes. Thriller, starring Johnny Messner, Matthew Marsden, KaDee Strickland and Nicholas Gonzalez.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: Under heavy pressure from her father, Beca reluctantly starts her first year at Barden University and gets an internship at the school radio station. She soon acquires a new circle of friends in the form of a band of misfits with a shared talent for singing, joining their a cappella group and trying to inject some much needed energy into their repertoire. Comedy, starring Anna Kendrick, Brittany Snow, Anna Camp, Rebel Wilson and Skylar Astin.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: A Cappella group the Barden Bellas enjoy an unprecedented run of success, until a disastrous performance sees them banned from national competitions and beset by scandal. They attempt to turn their fortunes around and redeem their reputation by competing in the World Championships of A Cappella in Copenhagen. Comedy sequel, starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Following their win at the world championship, the now-separated Bellas (an all-female a cappella singing group) reunite for one last singing competition at an overseas USO tour.
